title: luxury · described

turns.text: Make one image, aspect 1:1, from this exact description: Square, high-key studio product photograph of a single peach-pink perfume bottle shaped like a headless female torso, centered against a seamless pure white background. The bottle occupies approximately one-quarter of the frame’s width and five-sixths of its height, with generous empty space on both sides. Show the entire bottle straight-on at mid-bottle camera height, with a slight view of the top surfaces. Its clear glass outline forms sloping shoulders, a rounded bust, a deeply narrowed waist, broad curved hips, and a thick, flat rectangular base with rounded corners. Frosted blush-pink glass across the front suggests a fitted strapless bodice, while transparent outer edges and lower panels reveal pale salmon liquid and glossy glass thickness. A slender internal spray tube descends from the neck. Above the shoulders is a ribbed chrome collar and exposed polished silver atomizer, with black reflections, a small circular nozzle, and an elongated oval metal loop tilted toward the upper left. A small silver-edged white oval tag hangs at the right shoulder on a thin pale cord, reading “TIREZ” above “PULL” in tiny black uppercase letters, with a downward-pointing mark below. Broad, soft frontal and upper-left lighting creates white highlights along the glass edges. A faint peach reflection sits directly beneath the base on the glossy white surface.

must_haves: A luxury image matching the prompt.
